We will see whether Edward Iordanescu's players, who believe in winning the national championship, will break this disastrous series.

programme.title: I, the captain – Jakub Czerwiński | E07
programme.desc: Eight profiles of captains of clubs playing in the PKO Bank Polski Ekstraklasa. These are the top players on their teams. They are at different stages of their careers, have different personalities, life principles and stories, but they are united by their love for football and the desire to win. These are eight great leaders. This time we will meet the mainstay of Piast Gliwice's defense, Jakub Czerwiński. The 32-year-old has a menacing appearance, but is calm and hard-working. He values ​​professionalism and draws strength from his family and religion. Czerwiński won the Polish championship three times in his football career. He dreams of further successes with the Piast team. Poland. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: I was the king – Paweł Brożek | S01E05
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Paweł Brożek scored 149 goals in the Polish Ekstraklasa. This places him in eighth place in the all-time ranking of the highest league in our country. His goals contributed to Wisła Kraków winning seven Polish champion titles. Paweł Brożek became the top scorer twice. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Stuttgart – singles final match: Jelena Rybakina – Karolína Muchová
programme.desc: Both tennis players have a chance to win their second title this season. Jelena Rybakina won the Australian Open Grand Slam in January, and Karolína Muchová won the WTA 1000 tournament in Doha in February. The Kazakh will want to take revenge on the Czech for the defeat at the beginning of the year. In the quarterfinals of the event in Brisbane, she lost 1:2

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Linz - singles final match: Mirra Andreeva - Anastazja Potapova
programme.desc: It's time to crown a new champion of the tournament in Linz. It remains to be seen who will join the group of winners of this event, which includes Aryna Sabalenka and Victoria Azarenka. The winner of the competition will be 161,000 euros richer and her account in the WTA ranking will be credited with 500 points.

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Dubai – singles final match: Elina Svitolina – Jessica Pegula
programme.desc: The winner of the Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships will receive a prize of $597,000 and 1,000 WTA ranking points. This season, a new queen of courts on the Persian Gulf coast will be crowned. Last year's champion, Mirra Andreeva, was eliminated in the quarterfinals of the competition by Amanda Anisimova (6:2, 5:7, 6:7)

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Miami - singles final match: Aryna Sabalenka - Coco Gauff
programme.desc: Aryna Sabalenka is fighting not only for her second triumph in a row in Florida. Can join, among others: Iga Światek and won thousand runners in Indian Wells and Miami in one season. Coco Gauff wants to prevent her from doing so, as she wants to settle the score with the Belarusian. During the November WTA Finals, a defeat against the current leader of the ranking deprived the American of promotion to the top four of the tournament

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Miami – 2nd round singles match: Magda Linette – Iga Świątek
programme.desc: Elimination in the quarterfinals in Indian Wells caused Iga Świątek to drop to 3rd place in the WTA ranking. However, the Pole can quickly return to 2nd place thanks to the competition in Miami. However, she must count on Jelena Rybakina's stumble and also reach at least the quarterfinals. The first tennis player who will try to prevent the Raszynianka from doing so is Magda Linette. Our tennis players will meet on the court for only the second time in history. They previously faced each other in 2023 in Beijing. Świątek emerged victorious from that match, winning 6:1, 6:1

programme.title: 8 wonderful ones – Iga Świątek | S02E02
programme.desc: In women's tennis, the 2025 season culminated with the WTA Finals in Riyadh with the participation of the eight best players. programme.title: Leaders. In the center of the game – Radosław Murawski | E03
programme.desc: The series directed by Maciej Klimek presents five PKO BP Ekstraklasa players who took responsibility for their teams at the decisive moments of the 2025/26 season. The heroes are Jesus Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok), Rifet Kapić (Lechia Gdańsk), Radosław Murawski (Lech Poznań), Julian Shehu (Widzew Łódź) and Karol Czubak (Motor Lublin). Cameras follow them on and off the pitch, showing the pressure, behind-the-scenes of matches and their private lives. The story of Radosław Murawski, one of the key players of Lech Poznań, who struggled with a serious, months-long injury. The camera accompanies him during this difficult period. The player is fighting to return to the pitch, not knowing whether he will play at the highest level again. It is a story about determination, mental strength and support from loved ones, as well as the hope that he will be able to help the team defend the championship title. Poland. 2026. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Boo-Yah: A Portrait of Stuart Scott
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

From rescuing pets to caring for wild animals, they face new challenges every day. Watch as they save lives and create miracles, bringing light and hope to the animal world. Australia

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 11 p.
programme.desc: Join charming and energetic Sydney veterinarian Chris Brown and his team as they treat animals in the Bondi Beach area with great care and professionalism. From rescuing pets to caring for wild animals, they face new challenges every day. Watch as they save lives and create miracles, bringing light and hope to the animal world. Australia

programme.title: d/s Sharks. Declaration of love. 2 s.
programme.desc: Sharks are the oldest inhabitants of the ocean, having survived millions of years of evolution and retained their uniqueness to this day. We learn about the different species of sharks, their anatomy, behavior and ecology. Experts will talk about the myths and facts associated with these predators, dispelling many common misconceptions

programme.title: d/s Such different animals (Crocodiles)
programme.desc: Despite all the diversity of shapes and sizes, the animals of our planet are actually much more similar than they might seem at first glance. This fascinating documentary takes you on a fascinating journey to discover the surprising parallels between seemingly completely different species.

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 2 s.
programme.desc: The city, as one of the ecosystems on Earth, was the last to be born. It was created to satisfy human needs, but other living beings also strive to find their living space here. Temple of Heaven - home to many animals

programme.title: d/s Clean Water Gardens (Antarctica and Oceania)
programme.desc: In the new issue we explore the fragile “gardens” of life in the crystal clear waters of Antarctica and Oceania. Spain

programme.title: d/f Gibbon - a singing monkey. 1 p.
programme.desc: A distinct sound is heard that awakens the quiet forest. Some claim that this sound resembles human singing. These signals serve to convey signals and emotions. These little monkeys protect the life of a huge forest. These are singing monkeys - gibbons. We will reveal the secrets of their mysterious singing. South Korea

programme.title: d/s Love in the wild. 2 s.
programme.desc: The remaining couples travel through a maze of suspension bridges and encounter flying bats, caves, and rope-swinging adventures. France

programme.title: d/s Wild Namibia
programme.desc: The oldest and most inhospitable desert on the planet is becoming home to large animals that survive in these extreme conditions. In the absence of permanent bodies of water, life is supported only by short rivers, and only the hardiest and most adaptable inhabitants can survive in such harsh conditions. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/f Italy. Through places of wild nature (Forest of brown bears)
programme.desc: This episode follows the lives of a family of brown bears throughout the year, the mating season of fallow deer in the mountains of Central Italy, and the autumn migration of salamanders

programme.title: t/s Wild Killers (Beaks and Claws)
programme.desc: This issue contains a deadly arsenal of birds and predators. We'll see how eagle talons grab prey in flight, and the sharp beaks of herons become an ideal harpoon. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Wild animals of Europe (Wild bocage)
programme.desc: In a typical European countryside, wildlife is far more diverse than one might imagine, and it provides the backdrop for unexpected stories of survival. How do wild animals survive between agriculture and nature? France

programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore (Hidden Wildlife)
programme.desc: We have a fascinating journey through the city, where among the skyscrapers and highways there is an incredible diversity of wildlife, including rare species that were caught on camera for the first time. Dir.: Bill Morris, John Ruthven. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s On the brink of extinction (Mediterranean)
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Water world of Komodo Island (Dangerous creatures)
programme.desc: Off the coast of Komodo Island you can find an extremely dangerous sea predator - a shark. This is one of the most ruthless creatures of the underwater world. Almost all sharks have one thing in common - they are excellent hunters. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Germany

programme.title: d/f Wild Caribbean
programme.desc: The Caribbean archipelago is a chain of islands containing unique specimens of wildlife. Life took hold in this isolated environment, carried by winds, migrating birds or sea waves. Today these islands offer some of the richest biological resources in the world. This film explores this fascinating yet fragile wild Caribbean and its exceptional ecosystems. France

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 7 p.
programme.desc: The project immerses the viewer in the cruel but amazing world of wild nature, where every day is a struggle for life. Kill or be killed - these are the only rules of the game that animals obey. But how do they cope with these harsh conditions? How has evolution taught them to adapt and survive in a world full of dangers? Canada

programme.title: d/s Predatory instincts. 8 p.
programme.desc: The project immerses the viewer in the cruel but amazing world of wild nature, where every day is a struggle for life. Kill or be killed - these are the only rules of the game that animals obey. But how do they cope with these harsh conditions? How has evolution taught them to adapt and survive in a world full of dangers? Canada

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Reproduction tricks)
programme.desc: In this program we will find out what lengths animals go to in order to win the affection of the opposite sex. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: d/f The Underworld of the Savannah
programme.desc: Imagine a whole world immersed in the darkness of eternal night, where endless labyrinths hide thousands of amazing and mysterious inhabitants. This unexplored underground world lies at a depth of more than two meters under the savannahs of Africa, fraught with incredible secrets. Here, away from sunlight, an amazing ecosystem is formed, full of strange and wonderful creatures. France

programme.title: d/f Tyrone. 2 s.
programme.desc: Tayrona National Park, located on the Caribbean coast, is a unique ecosystem where different species of animals and plants intertwine. Once upon a time, the territory of the park was home to an ancient civilization, and now here you can find rare species of flora and fauna that have adapted to local conditions. Spain

programme.title: d/f Guadeloupe: from the peaks to the ocean
programme.desc: Embark on an unforgettable journey through an exotic island where volcanic peaks rise above tropical forests and rivers and waterfalls feed rich flora and fauna. You will get to know unique ecosystems, rare species of animals and plants, as well as the culture and traditions of local residents. Discover the secrets of Guadeloupe - from its inaccessible mountains to endless beaches and mysterious mangrove forests. France

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared (Disappearance or return)
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea

programme.title: Animal World Special Forces (Elite Troops)
programme.desc: Discover the most amazing and dangerous representatives of the wild, who have incredible abilities and talents. Get ready for fantastic discoveries! Dir.: Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic

programme.title: d/f Moremi: Kingdom of Hippos
programme.desc: When floods reach the Okavango Delta in Botswana, the hippos return to the Moremi Game Reserve, turning this piece of land into their kingdom. In this unique corner of nature, hippos play a vital role in maintaining the balance of the ecosystem, providing waterways for other animals and keeping many species alive during this difficult period for survival

programme.title: d/f Dragons from Komodo Island. Love story
programme.desc: The remote archipelago off the coast of Indonesia is home to the majestic Komodo dragons, the largest lizards in the world. Their life is a daily struggle for survival. There is always not enough water and food, and fierce battles break out for each female, in which several adult males participate at once. France

programme.title: d/f Raccoons: Survival Geniuses
programme.desc: Known for their curiosity and remarkable intelligence, raccoons become true survivalists. At a time when many species of animals are facing the threat of extinction, raccoons are experiencing a real boom, expanding their territories. Despite their cute appearance, they have an exceptional temperament and the ability to overcome any challenge. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Living Nature (Mountains. Ancient giants)
programme.desc: Since ancient times, mountains have delighted people with their grandeur, fascinated them with their beauty and inspired awe with their power. This issue talks about how the Earth's mountain ranges were formed and what legends have been born at their foothills for centuries. Russia

programme.desc: Từ những quy tắc nghiêm ngặt của Hammurabi cho đến con mắt ác độc bí mật, lịch sử đầy rẫy những hành động được thực hiện dưới danh nghĩa trả thù. Chúng tôi khám phá những thế lực đã thúc đẩy các cá nhân tìm cách trả thù.

programme.title: PAWN STARS S24 EP616
programme.desc: Rick và Corey chạy đua đến San Diego để lái chiếc xe cổ điển Hell's Chariot, từ bộ phim Grease. Cây gậy nóng rực lửa có phải là thứ họ mong muốn hay họ sẽ 'rút lui' khỏi thương vụ?

programme.title: MYSTERIES UNEARTHED WITH DANNY TREJO S1 EP01
programme.desc: Chúng tôi khám phá một số kho báu có giá trị nhất được tìm thấy theo những cách khó tin nhất. Giống như một bức tranh khảm La Mã cổ đại ẩn giấu trong một căn hộ, hay một món đồ Americana có giá trị được cất giấu ở chợ trời.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP02
programme.desc: Kho báu của vị vua Aztec biến mất trong không khí, truyền cảm hứng cho cuộc tìm kiếm kéo dài 500 năm xuyên lục địa. Một trong những chiến binh vĩ đại nhất mọi thời đại đã tích lũy được một đội quân đông đảo, nhưng tung tích của họ vẫn là một bí ẩn.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP15
programme.desc: Khi làn sóng bắt đầu chống lại các cường quốc phe Trục, các nhà lãnh đạo Đức và Nhật Bản triển khai các chiến lược trái ngược nhau trên mặt trận quê hương của họ.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP16
programme.desc: Việc chống lại sự chiếm đóng và áp bức của Đức Quốc xã diễn ra liên tục trong suốt cuộc chiến, với kết quả vừa thắng lợi vừa tàn khốc.

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP06
programme.desc: Chạy đua với cơn bão đang ập tới, Darrell Miklos và đội của anh buộc phải đưa ra những lựa chọn khó khăn. Nhưng sau một cuộc tìm kiếm kéo dài cả mùa giải, họ đã xác định được nguồn gốc của cú va chạm từ kế khổng lồ được ghi lại ở Mục tiêu 4.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP09
programme.desc: Nhóm có thông tin bí mật về một xác tàu có thể là vụ mất tích huyền thoại những năm 1930: chiếc du thuyền đua vô địch có tên Ingomar. Bị thu hút bởi ánh sáng, thủy thủ đoàn dày dạn kinh nghiệm của Ingomar lao vào chướng ngại vật.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S14 EP09
programme.desc: Troy và Pickle săn lùng vùng nước sâu nhất của đầm lầy. Ronnie vật lộn với một con cá sấu ăn thịt người đang phá hủy cơ hội thăng hạng của anh. Leron và Porkchop truy đuổi quái vật.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP15
programme.desc: Khi làn sóng bắt đầu chống lại các cường quốc phe Trục, các nhà lãnh đạo Đức và Nhật Bản triển khai các chiến lược trái ngược nhau trên mặt trận quê hương của họ.
